title: CAD Document Tree Name and Kind Labels
description: In the CAD document tree show the name for tree items and as second gray label show the kind (e.g. primary U2, secondary gray Unterzug).
summary: CAD document tree object items now show the object name as the primary label and the localized typology kind as the muted secondary description (e.g. "U2" + "Beam" / "Balken"). Extended typology_label to accept dynamic typology ids and covered the behavior with document_tree_shows_name_with_kind_as_secondary_label (EN + DE).
